title: Stop learning AI with a to-do app.
hook: Stop learning AI with a to-do app.
summary:
AI and football: stop learning AI with a to-do app.
For my dissertation I built a machine learning model that predicts a player's price from his stats. Think Mbappé or Neymar. Idea two: predict the other team's formation. Start with the Premier League, because lower league data is hard to find.
The method works for any hobby: pick what you care about, find the call people argue about, then ask where AI can speed it up.
I'm Manraj Sidhu, AI developer, and this is how I point AI at what I love.
Save this before your next AI course. Which "learn AI" advice would you call out? Tell me below.
